elaine: CI red on PR #4321 — prompt-render tests failing with a small snapshot diff. See excerpt:
```diff
-"Hello, world"
+"Hello, world "
```
Anyone seen a recent change that could add trailing spaces to serialized outputs? cc @anita
raf: I can take a look. Can you paste the failing test name and job link?
elaine: test_prompt_render::test_basic_prompt
https://ci.redwood.com/builds/4321
ci-bot: Job failed on gpu-queue-2 with exit code 1. Rerun allowed by author. (re-run button available)
raf: quick local repro: `pytest tests/render/test_prompt_render.py::test_basic_prompt -q -k basic_prompt -x`
jen: fyi I landed a small whitespace tweak in tokenizer on main earlier today, PR #4318 by anita — might be related
anita: yup that PR adjusted token join logic to preserve trailing space in some paths. Could be causing the extra space in serializer.
corey: If it's serializer mismatch we should avoid `--update-snapshots` yet. Instead run `python -m redwood.tools.snapshot_diff --expected path --actual path` and attach output.
mike: I can bisect overnight if no one picks it up. Suggest using `tools/ci-bisect --from=main~24 --to=HEAD --test=tests/render/test_prompt_render.py::test_basic_prompt`
elaine: thanks — I kicked a rerun from CI and attached the failing artifact. If rerun fails, mike can bisect. Also: try repro with env var `REDWOOD_SERIALIZER_COMPAT=old` and `=new` to isolate.
raf: repro with `REDWOOD_SERIALIZER=1 REDWOOD_SERIALIZER_COMPAT=old pytest tests/render/test_prompt_render.py::test_basic_prompt -q` showed old behavior (no trailing space). With `..._COMPAT=new` we get trailing space. Looks like serializer change in PR #4318 exposes it.
anita: I'll open a quick followup to adjust token join to strip when serializing prompts for tests. PR draft coming.
ci-bot: Rerun completed: still failing on new commit. Artifact: https://ci.redwood.com/artifacts/4321/render-diff.txt
corey: thanks — leave it with anita and mike. If it blocks release, we can revert the tokenizer tweak.
mike: I'll start bisect in the morning and share commands/output here.
elaine: appreciated. I'll mark the PR as blocked and ping infra if we need a point release revert. :thumbsup:
